name: Buttermilk Biscuits
notes: This mix can be pre-assembled in a ziploc bag (keep the buttermilk separate) and taken on camping trips for delicious dutch oven breakfasts. To substitute regular milk for buttermilk, add about 2 tsp lemon juice to 1 cup milk and let curdle before mixing with dry ingredients.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix in bowl: **2 cups flour**, **4 tsp baking powder**, **¾ tsp salt** and **¼ tsp baking soda**.

steps.title: Cut in the fat
steps.body: Cut in, until pea-sized chunks: **2 Tbsp butter** and **2 Tbsp shortening**.

steps.title: Add the buttermilk
steps.body: Add and mix in gently: **1 cup chilled buttermilk**.

steps.title: Fold the dough
steps.body: Turn out on floured counter, roll into a rectangle and fold in half. Repeat twice.

steps.title: Cut and bake
steps.body: Then cut into biscuits and bake at 450°F for 14–15 minutes.
